settings.intro_text:
Bottle washing has a way of quietly taking over your day. It’s not difficult, it’s just constant — you finish a few, and before you even realize it, there’s another set waiting. Over time, it stops feeling like a small task and starts feeling like something you’re always coming back to, no matter how many times you clear the sink.

This guide is built around that exact experience. Not from a feature-first perspective, but from what actually makes a difference when you’re dealing with this every single day — what helps you step away from the sink more often and reduces that repetition in a real routine.
settings.author_bio_override: Ethan Caldwell studies how everyday baby products fit into real routines, focusing on small, repetitive tasks that quietly take over parents’ days. He has worked with Philips Avent and other leading baby care brands, analyzing what truly helps families save time and effort.
